title: ProjectCell
description: Added cell that link projecte and ae2
body:
Provides a cell for ProjectE and AE2, allowing AE2 to access ProjectE's storage via the cell.
Added some EMC display configurations. If Project Expansion is also installed, please keep the default settings; otherwise, display issues may occur.

为projecte与ae2提供了一个磁盘，使ae2可以通过磁盘访问projecte的存储。
添加了一些emc的显示配置，在同时加入Project Expansion的状态下请保持默认状态，否则可能会有显示问题。
